svg.text: Automated Detection → Grouping → Remediation via Azure Automation + Microsoft Graph
• Creates/updates AAD groups per error code
Intune Proactive Remediations (one per error group)
• Detection script checks the specific condition • Remediation script runs the targeted fix
• Assigned to Intune-PatchError-{code} or Intune-AppError-{code} groups • Runs as SYSTEM
Restart BITS, clear SoftwareDistribution, check proxy/connectivity
gpupdate /force, verify WindowsUpdate reg keys, restart wuauserv
Restart-NetAdapter, netsh winsock reset, check firewall (outbound 443/80/8530)
Check WSUS URL in registry, verify firewall, restart wuauserv
Transient retry; ensure AC power, disable sleep: powercfg standby-timeout-ac 0
Clear WU cache (stop wuauserv, rm SoftwareDistribution), resync: /resetauthorization
DISM /RestoreHealth, check event logs, re-register WU DLLs, retry
Remove Winsxs\pending.xml, re-register WU DLLs, wuauclt /detectnow
Stop non-essential manual-start services, free RAM, increase page file
Audit with gpresult, ensure single WU source (GPO or Intune or SCCM, not mixed)
Restart BITS, clear Network\Downloader cache, check disk + connectivity
chkdsk C: /f /r, runs at next reboot
Clear SoftwareDistribution, re-register WU DLLs, wuauclt /resetauthorization
Kill hung msiexec, DISM /RestoreHealth, clean temp, retry install
Wait max 15 min for msiexec, kill stale instances (>1hr old), retry
Re-download & re-assign the app in Intune, check source path accessibility
clear $env:TEMP, $env:WINDIR\Temp, check disk space, verify folder permissions
Uninstall older version first, check Get-WmiObject Win32_Product for conflicts
Fix install command & arguments in Intune app configuration
Restart-Computer -Force, post-reboot the install may resume automatically
Verify detection script logic: file path, registry key, version string match what the app installs
Check OS version, architecture, disk space requirements in Intune app assignment
Set ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned, test script syntax locally, check for syntax errors
Simplify install script (Intune timeout is 30 min), avoid Start-Sleep loops
Correct the detection file path in Intune app configuration
cleanmgr /sagerun:1, clean WinSxS, rm temp files, expand volume
Verify install source files are uploaded to Intune, check UNC/local path if applicable
Stop non-essential services, increase page file, reboot
Schedule chkdsk C: /f /r at next reboot, retry install after
No remediation needed. Re-deploy with required (not available) assignment.
20 Patch error codes + 18 App error codes • One automated pipeline • Intune Proactive Remediations • Microsoft Graph API • Azure Automation
